CommunityApplications.Profile: FejesNAS utilities for Unraid 7. Fejes Mover Monitor offers Hungarian, US English and German Mover/cache monitoring and optional guarded native movement in the reviewed setup. Version 2026.11.18.2 includes red/blue cache threshold controls, persistent private run logs, readable event history, terminal hangup protection and verified coordinator-loss recovery. Completed downloads move to HDD and resume seeding, with configurable cache start/stop limits (default 75% / 65%), one complete unit per run up to 32 GiB and 128 files. Fresh isolated peer, hybrid-placement, recovery and installed-scheduler acceptance passed on Unraid 7.3.4. Observer remains the default; installation enables no movement or new schedule. Oversized/incomplete torrents stay in cache. Power-loss and compatibility limits are documented on GitHub.
